channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Joint Expeditionary Force ‘key tool’ to deter Russia
item.description: Asked by Graeme Downie MP, ministers said the UK-led Joint Expeditionary Force remains key to deterring Russian threats in the High North. The post Joint Expeditionary Force ‘key tool’ to deter Russia first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: First of seven new Scottish ferries start build in Poland
item.description: A keel-laying ceremony was held for the first ferry, while steel was cut for the second, confirming that the Small Vessel Replacement Programme has moved into full production. The post First of seven new Scottish ferries start build in Poland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK review may examine Iranian influence in Scotland
item.description: An independent UK review into foreign political interference could examine Iranian-linked activity targeting online debate around Scottish independence, following comments by Scotland Secretary Douglas Alexander. The review was announced after a former MEP was jailed for accepting Russian bribes and is expected to examine a wide range of foreign influence mechanisms, including covert digital operations. […] The post UK review may examine Iranian influence in Scotland first appeared on UK Defence

item.title: UK sends turrets and missiles in £600m Ukraine air push
item.description: The UK has announced a £600 million package of air-defence support for Ukraine, including automated counter-drone turrets and additional missile systems. The post UK sends turrets and missiles in £600m Ukraine air push first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK aircraft carrier to sail to Arctic for top secret mission
item.description: Britain's flagship aircraft carrier, HMS Prince of Wales, will sail soon for the Arctic Circle to support a secret multinational cargo mission at the North Pole, the UK Defence Journal has learned. The post UK aircraft carrier to sail to Arctic for top secret mission first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Rolls-Royce opens new engine overhaul facility in China
item.description: Rolls-Royce has officially opened Beijing Aero Engine Services Limited, a new maintenance, repair and overhaul joint venture with Air China, expanding its global capacity for servicing large civil aircraft engines. The post Rolls-Royce opens new engine overhaul facility in China first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. review clears V-22 safety concerns
item.description: The US Naval Air Systems Command has released the findings of a comprehensive review into the V-22 Osprey, reaffirming the aircraft’s airworthiness and allowing continued operations across the US Air Force, Marine Corps and Navy. The post U.S. review clears V-22 safety concerns first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: New British cruise missile enters firing trials
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that Project Brakestop, a new UK cruise missile programme designed for rapid production and scale, has entered live firing trials, as senior defence officials set out a shift toward faster weapons procurement. The post New British cruise missile enters firing trials first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK says General Dynamics currently ‘not in breach’ on Ajax
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said that General Dynamics is not currently in breach of its contract for the Ajax armoured vehicle programme, despite renewed concerns over safety, vibration issues and operational viability raised in Parliament. The post UK says General Dynamics currently ‘not in breach’ on Ajax first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ajax probe delays Defence Investment Plan decisions
item.description: Investigations into the Ajax armoured vehicle will shape decisions in the Defence Investment Plan, delaying the long awaited equipment spending document, as ministers await clarity on the troubled programme. The post Ajax probe delays Defence Investment Plan decisions first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
